prompt: Get top 5 users by total order value
response: SELECT u.id, SUM(o.total) FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active';

prompt: Find total revenue for each product category
response: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.name;

prompt: List users who placed orders greater than 1000
response: SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.total > 1000;

prompt: Get average order value per customer
response: SELECT user_id, AVG(total) FROM orders GROUP BY user_id;
SELECT id, name FROM products WHERE stock = 0;

prompt: List orders placed in the last 30 days
response: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at >= datetime('now', '-30 days');
SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users;
SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.id IS NULL;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month, SUM(total) FROM orders GROUP BY month;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE strftime('%Y', signup_date) = '2025';

prompt: List products out of stock with category name
response: SELECT p.name, c.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.stock = 0;
SELECT MAX(total) FROM orders;
SELECT salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

prompt: List all unique countries of customers
response: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM users;

prompt: Get count of orders per status
response: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

DELETE FROM users WHERE status = 'inactive' AND last_login < datetime('now', '-1 year');

prompt: Find average product price per category
response: SELECT c.name, AVG(p.price) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name;

prompt: List top 10 most active users by order count
response: SELECT u.id, u.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC LIMIT 10;
